_doc: Manifest of first-person logbook writing STYLES for the Story-tab chronicler. game/voices.js loads each id as data/voices/<id>.json, merged over data/voices/_defaults.json (first-person scaffolding) over data/chronicle-voice.json (structural base). Each captain/magistrate is assigned an opaque voiceSeed; the client picks its style with `voiceSeed % styles.length`, so every keeper's log reads in a distinct hand. Add a style: drop a <id>.json in this folder and append the id below. More styles → fewer repeats.
